title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
S01 E02 — Carnival and Bollywood
Master pastry chefs Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman face off in a battle of carnival treats, pulling out all the stops to create the ultimate sweets to satisfy a crowd of hungry amusement park patrons.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
S01 E03 — It's a Dog's Life
Pastry chefs Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman put their skills to the test making pies that are delicious and beautiful enough to impress the judges.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
S01 E04 — Wedding Wars
Duff Goldman brings Buddy Valastro into his world of fine dining with a challenge to create elegant plated desserts; in the cake-off, Buddy challenges Duff to create a cake for celebrity event planner Slomique Hawrylo's bridal fitting event.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
S01 E05 — Donuts and Magic
Kicking things off in the bake-off challenge, pastry chefs Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman have to handle the morning rush at Los Angeles' iconic Randy's Donuts drive-thru.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
S01 E06 — The Grand Finale
For the finale, pastry chefs Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman head to the Food Network Kitchen to create their most heartfelt and monumental creations yet -- chocolate desserts to conceal engagement rings for two surprise proposals.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
Buddy vs. Duff: Road to Rematch
Interviews with Buddy, Duff and their sous chefs set the stage for a big battle between the kings of cake.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
S02 E01 — Big Apple Cake
Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman bring their incredible cake contest to the East Coast; New York City is the inspiration for cakes that will be unveiled at a Big Apple event hosted by Debi Mazar and Rosanna Scotto.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
S02 E02 — Dinosaur Cake
Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman go on the ultimate adventure back in time to make the most realistic dinosaur cakes ever made as centerpieces for a fun-filled sleepover at the American Museum of Natural History.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
S02 E03 — Medieval Times Cake
Buddy and Duff create cakes full of special effects to celebrate the fantasy and fun of Medieval Times' 30th anniversary.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
S02 E04 — Waitress the Musical Cake
Jordin Sparks is finishing the lead in the Broadway musical Waitress, and she asks Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman to help her celebrate by creating detailed cakes for a huge wrap party.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
S02 E05 — Aquarium Cake
TV star and aquarium icon Isabella Gomez asks Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman to make cakes that bring viewers to an underwater world.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
S02 E06 — Mini-Golf Cake
Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman create cakes as playable holes for a putt-putt event hosted by LPGA tour professional golfer Michelle Wie.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
S02 E07 — Knott's Berry Cake
Buddy and Duff make cakes that look and move like theme park rides for Knott's Berry Farm's 100th anniversary.

title: Buddy vs. Duff
description:
S02 E08 — Star Wars Cake
For their final challenge, Buddy and Duff create their most elaborate cakes yet to celebrate Star Wars Day.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S03 E01 — Royal Cakes
Professional bakers are challenged to create perfect mini princess cakes; bakers then must create royal baby celebration cakes for 100 people using elderflower and lemon as the featured flavors; Marcela Valladolid, Jason Smith and Zac Young judge.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S03 E02 — Surprise Desserts
Eight bakers face a skills challenge that is all about mastery of molten lava cakes; in the master challenge, the bakers must create a smashable dessert using coconut as the featured flavor; guest judge, acclaimed pastry chef, Sherry Yard.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S03 E03 — Summer Vacation Desserts
Seven remaining bakers start out by making perfect floating island desserts; host Scott Conant asks them to create a flaming bombe Alaska with mango as the featured flavor; chocolatier Valerie Gordon joins judges Jason Smith and Marcela Valladolid.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S03 E04 — Classic French Pastries Reinvented
Bakers must re-create a beloved French classic, the éclair; the competitors have to re-imagine a classic French entremet cake using almond as the featured flavor; French pastry chef Florian Bellanger joins judges Jason Smith and Marcela Valladolid.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S03 E05 — Themed Desserts: Toy Story 4
The five remaining bakers make Toy Story-themed mini desserts; competitors each choose a character from "Toy Story 4" to replicate, they must include a flavor that speaks to the spirit of their character; pastry chef Shinmin Li joins the judges.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S03 E06 — Tiny and Tall Desserts
Bakers make miniature versions of two pastry classics; they each create a tall dessert of their choosing with at least 12 solid layers and sesame as the featured flavor; pastry chef Nancy Silverton joins judges Jason Smith and Marcela Valladolid.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S03 E07 — All-American Birthday Bash: Chocolate-Flavored
In a chocolate-themed finale, host Scott Conant challenges the three remaining bakers to create grown-up versions of a brownie sundae; the Master Challenge is to make a Happy Birthday USA chocolate fireworks cake to celebrate July 4th.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S02 E01 — Cake, Glorious Cake
Nine elite professional bakers gather to begin the first in a series of 14 challenges designed to test the limits of their baking mastery; in the master challenge, the bakers must create a mind-bending cake using vanilla as the featured flavor.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S02 E02 — Wedding Spectacular
The remaining eight bakers are charged with making perfect wedding-themed mini mousse cakes in the skills challenge; in the master challenge, the bakers must create a croquembouche-inspired wedding tower that uses champagne as the featured flavor.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S02 E03 — Summer Desserts
The bakers begin by making strawberry shortcake in the skills challenge; then, they must create a fire and ice dessert featuring one frozen element and one brûléed element; pastry chef Sherry Yard joins as a guest judge.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S02 E04 — East Coast Classics
The six bakers left in the competition face skills challenge to create flawless mini Boston cream pies; for the Master Challenge, the contestants are asked to bake their version of the ultimate New York cheesecake with apple as the featured flavor.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S02 E05 — Magnificent Meringue
The five remaining bakers must make mini meringue pies and use raspberry flavor in a classical French layered meringue cake called a marjolaine; pastry chef Shinmin Li serves as a guest judge.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S02 E06 — Old-School Classics
The four remaining bakers make historic Mont Blanc cakes, tarts topped with a tower of chestnut paste; in the Master Challenge, the bakers have to make a Charlotte Royale -- also known as brain cake -- with peanut butter as the featured flavor.

title: Best Baker in America
description:
S02 E07 — Chocolate Crescendo
In the Skills Challenge, the three remaining bakers must create a perfect version of the glazed Austrian chocolate cake called Sachertorte.

A chocolate dessert from an Asian drink and dried fungi; onions and a strong-flavored candy; black radishes and mini ice cream cones.

description:

Chocolate desserts with ketchup; a candy test with instant noodles and fruit; marriage themed test.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E01 — Carnivals, Cityscapes and Glowing Cakes
A carnival-themed wedding cake complete with a tunnel of love; a massive edible Hollywood cityscape pleases everyone at a fundraiser; a glow-in-the-dark jellyfish cake; a piñata that looks so real it's hard to believe it's actually a cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E02 — Surprise Filled Cakes
A rancher's birthday party calls for a pair of larger-than-life cowboy boots; the Texas Reptile Zoo celebrates with a realistic snake cake that blows everyone's mind; two special cakes hold hidden surprises.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E03 — Gravity-Defying Musical Cakes
A '50s-themed cake with a working jukebox; an out-of-this-world wedding cake gets filled with hand-sculpted edible zombies; an alligator groom's cake; a baker defies gravity with a floating ballet slipper over a stylish baby shower cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E04 — Out Of This World, Upside Down Cakes
An upside-down wedding cake hanging from a chandelier covered in sparkly rhinestones; an edible truck jumps over a Vegas ghost town; planet Earth cake; one baker creates a realistic, 3-D motorcycle cake that's multicolored on the inside.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E05 — Beer, Bling And Spinning Cakes
A brewery celebration calls for kegs made of cake that actually pour beer; an edible sombrero filled with food and flames; an almost life-sized golf cart cake is a hole in one; twins request a spinning birthday cake with extra bling.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E06 — Magical and Mysterious Cakes
Two edible dragons battle it out across a running stream; a sci-fi wedding cake transports the bride and groom to another planet; an office is fooled by an edible, life-sized desk; a cake for an aquarium.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E07 — Castles, Coral and Camo Cakes
A cake from Down Under brings a mermaid and sea creatures to life; revealing a baby's gender with fairytale castle flair; a wedding cake captures the couple's love of deer hunting; a patriotic cake honors military heroes.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E08 — Doughnut Dumbbells and a Wine Fountain Cake
A fountain of wine pours from an edible bottle for a vineyard party; two brothers celebrate their engagements with an elephant cake; dumbbells look like doughnuts; people are shocked when the longhorn skull hanging on the wall is cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E01 — Jaw-Dropping Fantasy Cakes
A cake of Jurassic proportions for a group of movie super fans; a 30th birthday calls for an elaborate dessert, which brings a woodland creature to life; a cake filled with special effects that interact with a video game.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E03 — Oversized, Underwater Cakes
Teachers are over the moon for a spaceship cake filled with cinnamon apples; an oversized pizza cake can barely fit into the restaurant for delivery; an underwater creature comes to life for a third birthday party.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E04 — Realistic Animal Cakes
An unusual animal race has one baker building a cake like no other; a Chinese New Year celebration cake; dinner guests are fooled when dessert comes early; a baker in Texas builds a treat that's so realistic it's hard to tell its cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E05 — Waterfall and Wonder Wheel Cakes
Volunteers are surprised by a yin-and-yang-inspired sweet treat; a bride is overwhelmed with joy when her wedding cake gets its own water feature; a cake design that's big enough for someone to hide inside; a Coney Island celebration.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E06 — Glowing, Patriotic Cakes
Guests at a Vegas party go crazy for a chocolate stout cake; a girl's birthday dreams come true as her favorite pink-haired character comes to life; a veteran's family is celebrated with a patriotic cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E07 — Leprechaun and Mermaid Cakes
A giant leprechaun cake completes a St. Patrick's Day party; one bride's floral fairytale becomes a reality with 2,600 edible homemade flowers; savory dishes that look like anything but cake; a boss makes a cake for an aquarium.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E08 — Spinning, Lifelike Cakes
A flaming fire truck cake comes with a water hose; a produce stand that doesn't include any actual vegetables; an adorable, edible cat is suspended in midair; a wintry wedding cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E09 — Cookies and Feathers Cakes
A baker sculpts a sweet wonderland; the Los Angeles Cookie Con gets a special treat; bridal shower guests don't realize that the table decor is actually the cake; a 40th birthday cake takes flight.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E10 — Ostriches, Tacos and More!
A flightless bird of epic proportions comes to life in Dallas; taco fillings are piled high on a giant confectionary shell; a birthday girl's face is reimagined on a cake; bakers in Las Vegas need a forklift.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E11 — Levitating, Robotic Cake
A levitating wedding cake amazes a room full of guests; a shiny robot cake makes waves in New Jersey; working hydraulics take a car-shaped cake up a notch; a 5-foot tall cake makes a wedding display like no other.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E12 — Bears and Pinball Cakes
Bakers in Texas create an unbearably cool cake that has an element of surprise; a knight in shining armor becomes a cake fit for medieval royalty; a bar mitzvah cake is filled with the celebrant's favorite things; an edible pinball cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E13 — Fiery, Fairytale Cakes
A waterfront wedding cake gets its own functioning river; an island-themed cake erupts with Polynesian flair; a fairytale Vegas wedding cake is taller than the bride; a baker adds fire to a mystical beast.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E01 — Sea Creatures and Corvette Cakes
Young buccaneers are treated to a cake filled with treasure; car connoisseurs enjoy a replica cake that is ready to roll; a dessert for a local bagel shop has all the customers fooled.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E02 — Fierce, Festive Cakes
A baker is excited to create a massive shark cake to celebrate Discovery's Shark Week; a bride and groom are floored when their gorgeous wedding cake spins; a casino hits the jackpot.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E03 — Cities, Skates and Jellyfish Cakes
A birthday girl is thrilled with an underwater creature cake; a wedding cake combines two cities into one epic display; a sculpted bust that is ready for the rink; a cook-off between the fire department and the police department.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E04 — Legendary Adventure Cakes
A couple's honeymoon travels inspire an adventure-filled cake; a unique Route 66 cake; a couple is delighted when their massive wedding cake spins; a famous photographer is honored with a cake modeled after his favorite canine.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E05 — Italian Food and Instrument Cakes
A cake to celebrate retiring music teachers is so realistic it looks ready to play a tune; a family reunion cake is topped off with a barrel of crabs; a dress cake with colorful details; a realistic platter of Italian favorites.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E06 — Over-the-Top Birthday Cakes
A magical, spinning cake that's bursting with color and a surprise Sweet 16 cake covered in sparkles and bling; An out-of-this-world cake brings the birthday girl's imagination to life; a cake filled with cute creatures and critters.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E08 — Magical Character Cakes
Artists create a tall chocolate sculpture of a Texas state fair icon; other projects include a birthday cake featuring realistic fairies and a large-scale cake shaped like an Irish bear.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E09 — Fancy Flower and Farm Cakes
A baker designs an epic pop culture wedding cake with a massive dragon; customers in a coffee shop are pleasantly surprised by a sweet creation with an edible mug; a florist's vision comes to life when chocolate petals form one massive rose.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E10 — Flying and Golden Cakes
Bakers make penguins fly on a snowy cake filled with special effects; savory turns sweet when po' boys are made out of cake; Las Vegas bling is taken to another level with gold fondant and handmade sugar flowers; a movie camera cake with popcorn.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E11 — Luxurious and Playful Cakes
Luxurious details and elegant decor make for a most-extravagant wedding cake. Then zoo animals come to life, sugar looks like hand-blown glass, and a duck rides a mechanical bull on a super playful birthday cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E12 — Dinosaurs and Golden Gate Cakes
A baker brings the Diabloceratops back from extinction; wedding dreams come true with a miniature bride and groom lookalike topper; the San Francisco skyline is recreated in a detailed cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E13 — Big Ben and Wearable Hat Cakes
London comes to Las Vegas in a wedding shower creation; cake and ice cream get a whole new meaning; a spinning masterpiece shines like crystals; a baker creates an unbelievable cake that's a wearable hat.

title: Cake Wars
description:

The Simpsons family is throwing a huge bash to celebrate their success and the winning cake maker will have their creation front and center at the event.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S01 E02 — DC Comics
DC Comics is looking for the best cake maker to create a centerpiece for their celebration; judges Ron-Ben Israel and Waylynn Lucas will be joined by Dan DiDio, Geoff Johns and Jim Lee, senior executives and comic book artists for DC Comics.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S01 E03 — The Knot
The winning cake will be featured at a couple's dream wedding where everything has been provided by Theknot.com, except the cake.

title: Cake Wars
description:

Super Mario Bros video game is being represented in cake form; the winning cake will be featured at a celebration for Nintendo's Mario Maker; Krysta Yang, from Nintendo of America, is on hand to help judge the results.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S01 E05 — Hello Kitty
The bakers vie to have their cake creation featured at the celebration for the launch of Hello Kitty's North American tour; actress Katherine McNamara judges the results.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S01 E06 — Lego
Four bakers piece together LEGO-themed cake creations, with the winner's cake being at the center of a party at LEGO's flagship store; guest Michael McNally, senior director of brand relations for LEGO Group, helps judge the results.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S01 E07 — The Sound of Music
Four cake artists must create a cake that takes inspiration from the movie classic, "The Sound of Music."

title: Cake Wars
description:

Four cake artists compete to have their cake creation at the center of a massive celebration for the Girl Scouts of the USA.

description:

description:
S02 E02 — Dr. Seuss
A cake artist's creation will be at the center of a celebration honoring children's book author Dr. Seuss and the posthumous publication of his book, "What Pet Should I Get?"

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E03 — Kung Fu Panda 3
The release of the animated movie "Kung Fu Panda 3" is celebrated as four bakers compete to impress the movie's directors.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E04 — Minecraft
The winning cake creation will be the centerpiece at a party celebrating one of the biggest video games of all time, Minecraft; Brand Director for Minecraft, Lydia Winters, is on hand to help the judge the results.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E05 — Valentine's Day
With the help of an expert chocolatier, the four bakers put their heart into their Valentine's Day cake creations; chocolatier Jonathan Grahm joins the judging panel.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E06 — Shark Lagoon
The Aquarium of the Pacific throws a celebration for their Shark Lagoon nights, and the four bakers battle for the chance to have their cake creation be the centerpiece of the party.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E07 — Shrek
DreamWorks Animation is throwing a massive party to celebrate the 15th Anniversary of the iconic animated film, "Shrek"; producer Gina Shay helps judge the baker's creations.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E08 — Party Animals
Four bakers are challenged with creating amazing cake creations celebrating the first birthday of Rosie the baby hippo from the Los Angeles Zoo.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E09 — Sesame Street
Four cake makers compete to have their creation at the center of an epic party celebrating the latest season of Sesame Street.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E10 — Willy Wonka
The bakers compete to have their scrumdiddlyumptious cake creation at the center of an event celebrating the 45th anniversary of the all-time classic film "Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory."

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E11 — Archie
Archie, Jughead, Betty, Veronica and the whole gang are headed for Cake Wars, as four master cake artists battle to have their creations at the center of a party celebrating 75 years of the iconic comic book.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E12 — Dinosaurs
Cake artists battle to capture dinosaurs in cake form; Jesse Daniel from the National History Museum of Los Angeles joins the judging panel.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E13 — Alice in Wonderland
Bakers put their skills to the test and take on Alice in Wonderland in cake form; Mike Gabriel, Production Designer and Filmmaker at Disney Animation Studios, joins as special guest judge.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S03 E01 — Captain America
Talented bakers take on the iconic comic book hero, Captain America; one of four talented bakers will take their cake creation to a party celebrating the super-soldier hero's 75th birthday; guest judge, Stephen Wacker, VP of Animation at Marvel.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S03 E02 — SpongeBob
Four bakers battle to have their amazing cake as the centerpiece of a party celebrating SpongeBob SquarePants; Tom Kenny, the voice of SpongeBob himself, serves as guest judge.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S03 E03 — Charlie Brown's All-Stars
Bakers work on creations to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the iconic special "Charlie Brown's All-Stars!"; guest judge Lindsey Schulz, granddaughter of Peanuts creator Charles Schulz.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S03 E04 — How to Train Your Dragon
Four bakers compete to have their cake creations at the center of a party celebrating the animated franchise "How to Train Your Dragon"; judges Art Brown and Doug Sloan, executive producers of "Dragons: Race to the Edge."

title: Cake Wars
description:
S03 E05 — Emoji
Four artists take on the challenge of creating cakes with an emoji theme; with guest judge Gedeon Maheux, co-founder of Iconfactory.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S03 E06 — Cobra's Curse
Four bakers compete in an Egyptian adventure when they are tasked with creating a cake as a centerpiece of a party celebrating the grand opening of Busch Gardens Tampa Bay's newest thrill ride, Cobra's Curse.
